name: prompt-run
about: An 18-20 s demo of a product that does work from a request, one object through many states: a pill holding what it is among the real marks of the tools it connects; on the kick the label swaps; into the request box out of the pill, where the request types; a punch-in and the send; a whip up into the run (the request as a bubble with the people it is for, the steps checking in under the film's one 3D turn); the result; the lockup. The lines land on a dealt confident voice (mask, land or fall), the grounds are clean lit pages, and each act deals one of two or three devices per film from a seed (src/deal.ts), so no two films play one sequence. new-film.sh --template prompt-run lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every demo is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): its kick carries the swap and the act lines; earshot effects mark the product's state changes (the click, the checks, the result); never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 110-136 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); a clear kick suits the swap on the kick
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template prompt-run --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end auto  (its own ending, else a fade: never a cut)

deal.about: Each act is a slot with two or three devices on the same cues and words. src/deal.ts deals one per slot from a seed (the product's name, or SEED) under its RULES (one colour event per film); PIN chooses one by hand. The timeline's declarations follow the deal (the iris's field or the claim's flood as the colour event, the seams).

voice.mask: each word rises out of a mask on its baseline
voice.land: the line lands from oversized on a glide
voice.fall: each word drops into place, the last in the accent

open.ring: the tools' tiles tumble in round the pill, orbit and fly off on the kick
open.dock: the tiles fly into the pill on the kick and dock as a row of marks beside the second label
open.wall: the tiles stand on the far plane of a depth stack behind the pill, the camera pushing through

ask.iris: the iris opens out of the pill onto the accent (the colour event) and the field wipes up off the frame
ask.stretch: the pill itself stretches into the request box, no cut

click.pointer: the pointer glides in on an arc and clicks
click.tap: a tap lands on the send button, a press ring opening from its rim

run.list: the run in one lit panel the camera swings round to face
run.stack: each step a card landing in a depth stack, the camera pushing through on a turn
run.split: the run beside the product's own dense screen, its lens moving to the row each step touches

done.morph: the running row grows into the result card
done.claim: the accent rises over the run and the result line is the claim on it (the colour event)

end.pop: the mark lands and the name slides out from behind it
end.assemble: the mark's parts glide in from three sides and lock
